title: Chapter 8
text:
Han Xiao changed into the guard's uniform and left Lin Wei Xian's lab.

Many people in the base knew that he was taken away by Lin Wei Xian, so he couldn't appear in his original identity for the time being. Only four people had a deep impression of him — Hella, Number One, Lin Wei Xian, and Baltar. The first two were not in the base, and Lin Wei Xian had been killed by him. As long as he didn't run into Baltar, he would be safe for the time being.

The door to the underground lab was made of a special alloy that was eighty centimeters thick. Even all the explosives in the armory would not be able to blow it open. The only way was through the electronic access control. Only three people had the right to open the door, and Lin Wei Xian was one of them.

A pure white card was lying quietly in Han Xiao's shirt pocket at that moment.

However, there were sentries guarding the entrance, and the first floor was the guard's dormitory. Everyone here knew the three people with the white cards, so it was impossible to fool them. Beside the sentries was an emergency door closing device. As long as the gate was pulled, the access control system would be manually turned off, and the door would be completely locked. If Han Xiao swaggered into the lab with the white card, there would be no way out and he would be surrounded within ten seconds. At that time, it would be like catching a turtle in a jar. A single bullet could take away dozens of health points. If he was lucky, he would probably be able to survive for 0.8 seconds.

Hmm, very heroic. Not a bad way to die. He decided to keep this as a backup option.

Han Xiao's plan was to cut off the communication and buy himself a few hours of free time. This was the safest way. In fact, the original plan was to destroy the power supply, but the access control system was electrified. Cutting off the power supply would cause it to stop working.

The transmitter for the communication signal was hidden in the wall of the third floor underground. He would need a mechanical arm to break through the wall.

The machinery modification room was on the second floor underground. Han Xiao had to go back to get his equipment first.

However, plans could never keep up with changes.

When he was only fifty meters away from the machinery modification room, a large hand suddenly reached out from the side and pressed on his chest. Han Xiao's eyes narrowed. The person who stopped him was Baltar!

The base was so big, so why did he have to run into Baltar, the person he least wanted to run into? What kind of luck was this? Was Murphy the embodiment of fate?

"Which group are you from? Why haven't I seen you before?" Baltar asked.

Han Xiao lowered his head and covered his face with his cap. "I'm new. I'm in Team B."

Baltar looked suspicious. "When did we get new people? How come I didn't know? I think I've heard your voice somewhere before. Raise your head and let me see your face. "

Han Xiao glanced at Baltar from the corner of his eye. He saw that Baltar's hand was already reaching for the pistol at his waist, ready to fire at any time. The other three guards also sensed that something was wrong and moved closer.

What to do? If they were discovered, Baltar would definitely send someone to look for Lin Wei Xian. Once Lin Wei Xian's body was discovered, his actions would be exposed. So, was it really necessary to dismember the body before leaving? No, no, no. For the sake of my appetite in the next few days, I shouldn't do such a thing … Die here? Don't have that kind of thinking. You have to have confidence in everything you do. If it's obvious that you'll die if you fail, don't think about failure before thinking about victory.

"How troublesome … I didn't want to use Plan B in the first place."

"What are you talking about?" Baltar didn't hear him clearly.

Han Xiao suddenly raised his head and revealed a dangerous smile. "I've always wanted to tell you that you should go see a psychiatrist!"

"Zero?!"

While Baltar was still in shock, Han Xiao took the initiative and stabbed his dagger into Baltar's chest. Baltar's pupils constricted, and he hurriedly leaned back. The dagger grazed his chin and cut open his flesh, leaving behind a trail of blood.

"Shoot!" The three guards hurriedly pulled out their guns, but they were too close to Han Xiao. They were less than three meters away, which was not a good distance for a gun fight. Han Xiao strode across the three meters and punched one of the guards in the face. If there was a slow-motion replay, one would see the skin on his face tremble like a ripple.

-48！

The powerful punch stunned the guard. He staggered and knocked into his two companions, and the three of them fell to the ground.

Han Xiao decisively turned around and sprinted toward the machinery modification room. Gunshots rang out behind him, and the bullets brushed past him, creating sparks on the wall.

Baltar held his bleeding chin, and his expression was gloomy. He raised his gun and fired wildly at Han Xiao.

"All agents, reinforce the machinery modification room on the second floor immediately. Target Zero, the test subject is out of control!" Baltar shouted into the mini walkie-talkie on his collar.

The patrolling guards on each floor were shocked. They thought they were hallucinating.

"Zero out of control? Are you kidding me? "

"Wasn't the test subject brainwashed?"

"Is this a drill?"

"Are you stupid? I heard the gunshots!"

Han Xiao suddenly became extremely calm. This was his special state of focus. His mind was as cold as ice, and his mind was cold as ice. Countless pieces of information gathered in his mind. The world in front of him became a crisscrossing grid, like a spider's web. Everything was connected.

"Reach the machinery modification room in two seconds. Baltar will take 3.7 seconds to catch up. The three guards won't be a threat to me for 4.2 seconds. Reinforcements will take 25 to 35 seconds to arrive …"

Han Xiao had been through countless battles. His rich combat experience was the basis of his ability to maintain this state.

He ran like a snake, completely focused on dodging the bullets.

Baltar chased after him. He didn't care about why Zero had lost control. He knew that his job was to capture Han Xiao. If necessary, he could even kill him on the spot.

"Interesting. The little toy wants to resist." Baltar licked the blood on his chin. "This is the way you chose to die!"

Although he was ambushed by Han Xiao, Baltar was still very confident. He was an elite agent with twenty years of experience. Even if Zero was a fast learner, he had only trained for half a year. How many of his moves could Zero block? And by the looks of it, Zero was panicking.

Han Xiao ran into the machinery modification room and slammed the door shut.

"You chose to hide in a room. This is a dead end. You're too inexperienced!"

Baltar sneered and rushed to the door. He raised his foot and was about to kick it open. He quickly reloaded his magazine and was ready to fire a round of bullets once the door was opened.

Suddenly, something happened!

The door exploded into pieces. A mechanical fist with a metallic hue broke through the door. The engine roared, and the silver fist smashed into Baltar's chest.

-95！

It was the sound of bones breaking!

Baltar was sent flying like a ragdoll and slammed into the wall. His ribs were broken, and his gun was knocked out of his hand. He spat out a mouthful of blood as he stared at Han Xiao, who was now a completely different person.

At this time, Han Xiao's left hand was equipped with an exoskeleton light mechanical arm. It was like a large arm armor, covering his arm. The hinges and gears were rotating, making the sound of springs. The metal fingers moved nimbly, and the exposed pipes spewed out black smoke from the engine, like a black cloud that surrounded his arm.

"What the hell is this?!" Baltar's eyes widened in horror.

Not far away, three guards aimed their guns. Han Xiao was one step ahead of them. He raised his Enhanced Type 73 WASP and fired two shots.

Dexterity affected shooting accuracy, and skills had accuracy modifiers. Han Xiao's marksmanship was amazing. The bullets hit the eyes and throat of the two guards, triggering lethal damage and killing them instantly.

The third guard fired, and the bullet whistled toward him. Han Xiao raised his mechanical arm first, and with a clang, the bullet bounced off the outer layer of the mechanical arm.

Lightweight Mechanical Arm (Left) lost 8 points of durability.

Han Xiao fired another shot, sending the third person to the afterlife.

The guard's eyes widened before he died. He could not believe that the silent and dull zero was so strong.

Didn't they say that the test subjects were brainwashed?

It was all a lie!

The corridor was quiet. Only Han Xiao and Baltar were left.

"It will take about thirty seconds for the nearest guard to arrive." Han Xiao moved the mechanical arm and said calmly, "I want to break your neck with my own hands to thank you for the 420 cuts you inflicted on me in the past six months."

Baltar's eyes were fierce as he spat out a mouthful of bloody phlegm. He pulled out a dagger from his military boots and bent down, ready to pounce at any moment. He sneered, "That punch was powerful enough, but you're dreaming if you think you can beat me with this broken machine!"

"Prove it."

"Thirty seconds is enough for me to kill you ten times over!" Baltar roared and pounced with his dagger like a cheetah. Han Xiao raised the mechanical arm in front of him and clashed head-on with Baltar.

Sparks flew as the dagger clashed against the armor. The moment the two of them passed each other, Baltar twisted his waist and swung his leg, aiming for Han Xiao's knee like a scorpion raising its tail. Kicking the enemy from behind and cutting the neck with a dagger was a very powerful move. Han Xiao, who had been trained by Hella, knew that Baltar would use this move. He reacted quickly and swung the mechanical arm backward, hitting Baltar's leg. The sound of bone cracking could be heard.

-87！

The mechanical arm's energy level was thirty-eight. Combined with Han Xiao's own energy level, it was almost at the standard of a Grade E Super.

The Lightweight Mechanical Arm doubled Han Xiao's attack power. Even though it was not enough to crush Baltar, every hit dealt around 90 damage, which was quite impressive. Baltar's health was only slightly more than 300, and that was with the addition of the Well-Trained Talent. Coupled with the punch that he had used to break through the door, Baltar's health had been reduced to less than half. Baltar's health was starting to weaken.

Baltar groaned and endured the pain. He stabbed his dagger toward Han Xiao's eyes, but his movement had slowed down, and the mechanical arm caught his dagger.

"Impossible! How can I lose? You …"

Baltar roared, unwilling to give up. He wanted to fight back.

As soon as he finished speaking, his vision suddenly turned black. The mechanical palm pressed down on his head and smashed him into the wall. The tyrannical strength directly suppressed his angry roar back into his throat.

"Bang!"

Gravel flew everywhere as blood and flesh flew everywhere.

Han Xiao's eyes were cold. He slammed Baltar's head against the wall and pulled, leaving a deep red mark.

Baltar's face, which had been rubbed against the wall, had become a bloody mess that was beyond recognition.

Han Xiao let go, and Baltar fell to the ground like a puddle of mud. He was no longer as arrogant as before.

"Sorry, I went back on my word and didn't break your neck. How about you get up and let me kill you again?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

Baltar did not answer. He did not have the chance to.

You have killed Valkyrie Laboratory Assistant Manager Baltar. You have received 1,500 EXP.
